select id as examId, title as examTitle, 1 as neededMark from t_exam
is_deleted = 0 and (saq_count > 0 or (fill_count > 0 and fill_need_mark = 1))
and ( user_id = #{userId} or id in ( select eg.exam_id from t_exam_grade eg where eg.grade_id in ( select g.id from t_grade g where g.user_id = #{userId} union select ug.g_id from t_user_grade ug where ug.u_id = #{userId} and (ug.is_deleted = 0 or ug.is_deleted is null) ) ) )
and title like concat('%',#{examName},'%')

select e.id as id,e.title as title,e.exam_duration as examDuration,e.passed_score as passedScore, e.gross_score as grossScore,e.max_count as maxCount,e.user_id as userId,e.certificate_id as certificateId, e.radio_count as radioCount,e.radio_score as radioScore,e.multi_count as multi_count,e.multi_score as multiScore, e.judge_count as judgeCount,e.judge_score as judgeScore,e.saq_count as saqCount,e.saq_score as saqScore, e.fill_count as fillCount,e.fill_score as fillScore,e.fill_need_mark as fillNeedMark, e.start_time as startTime,e.end_time as endTime,e.create_time as createTime,u.user_time as userTime,u.user_score as userScore, u.limit_time as limitTime,u.whether_mark as whetherMark,u.state as state from t_exam e join t_user_exams_score as u on u.exam_id = e.id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.state = 1 and e.is_deleted = 0
and e.title like concat('%',#{examName},'%')
order by u.create_time
ASC
DESC
